name: Moz
description: Moz Pro is an all-in-one SEO software suite offering keyword research, backlink analysis with Domain Authority (DA), rank tracking, and automated technical site audits.
best_for: In-house SEO specialists, small agencies, and marketing consultants seeking trusted Domain Authority metrics and site audit tools.
features: Keyword Explorer providing keyword volume, difficulty scores, and organic CTR estimations
Link Explorer tracking backlinks, anchor text distribution, and proprietary Domain Authority / Page Authority metrics
Weekly automated technical site crawls identifying broken links, duplicate content, and meta tag issues
Rank tracking across desktop and mobile SERPs with regional and local search engine targeting
On-page optimization grader providing actionable content recommendations per target keyword
Custom scheduled PDF reporting for client presentations and executive stakeholders

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Track 300 keywords, 1 user seat, 100k page crawls per month (billed annually at $79/mo or $99/mo monthly).

tiers.name: Medium
tiers.notes: Track 1,500 keywords, 2 user seats, 500k page crawls.

tiers.name: Large
tiers.notes: Track 3,000 keywords, 3 user seats, 1.25M page crawls.

pros: Widely recognized Domain Authority (DA) and Page Authority (PA) link metrics
Beginner-friendly interface with extensive SEO educational resources (Moz Academy)
Accurate keyword difficulty scores and organic click-through rate predictive models
cons: Backlink index refresh speed and total database size are smaller than Ahrefs and Semrush
Standard plan limits user seats to 1 and keyword tracking to 300 terms
Lacks integrated PPC ad competitor intelligence compared to Semrush

alternatives.name: Semrush
alternatives.description: Comprehensive digital marketing suite covering SEO, PPC, content marketing, and social media.
alternatives.best_for: Marketing teams wanting combined SEO, competitor PPC, and content optimization

alternatives.name: Ahrefs
alternatives.description: Industry-leading SEO software suite powered by the web largest commercial web crawler.
alternatives.best_for: Advanced SEO professionals prioritizing backlink analysis and technical auditing
